notes.title: 《Shacheng Overlord》Server Launch Announcement – Two Years in the Making
notes.content:
[p]🔥 [b]Two Years of Dedication! Crafted with Passion! A Legendary Innovation![/b]
[b]Game Background[/b]:
In the primordial chaos of an ancient continent, the war between gods and demons tore the heavens and earth apart, leaving behind endless ruins and mysterious powers. A thousand years later, humanity rises, only to be plunged into endless conflict over the "Shacheng"—a city symbolizing supreme power that hides the secret to the divine realm! As a legendary warrior chosen by fate, you will embark on an epic journey to conquer Shacheng, uncover the truth, and unify the continent! Will you become a revered overlord worshipped by millions, or fade into the annals of history? The choice is yours to write![/p][p]🌟 [b]Launch Bonanza: Overwhelming Rewards, Play Without Grinding or Paying![/b]
✅ [b]Log in to claim the【Gold Card Player】title[/b]: Join the group (413822706) or leave a game review to receive free first-recharge rewards + exclusive perks! Every hit deals green poison + super slicing damage—mobs crumble instantly!
✅ [b]300+ exclusive buffs for custom builds[/b]: Crit, life steal, invincibility—define your playstyle with endless combinations!
✅ [b]All gear drops from monsters! Max drop rates unlocked![/b] One map, one monster, one unique drop—soar to greatness at lightning speed!
✅ [b]Super Clone System[/b]: Summon up to 20 clones with stats synced to your character. Slaughter mobs like grass, dominate the server while AFK!
✅ [b]Random trigger: Infinite attack speed +999%[/b]: Deal 9,999,999 damage per swing—obliterate bosses in seconds![/p][p]🎮 [b]Gameplay Unveiled: Zero-Cost Clearance, F2P to Godhood![/b]
1️⃣ [b]Newbie Boost[/b]: Follow the main quest to level up titles/reincarnation/rank, unlocking massive slicing damage—mobs die in one hit!
2️⃣ [b]Clone Dominance[/b]: Complete the main story in Zone 1 to unlock the Super Clone! Upgrade and fuse clones in Zone 2 for explosive damage—solo the entire server!
3️⃣ [b]Sky Tower Challenge[/b]: Test your limits in Turf City’s gauntlet. First kills drop legendary gear—rewards rain down!
4️⃣ [b]F2P Paradise[/b]: VIP, sponsorships, and cumulative recharges are all FREE! Grind mobs, complete quests, and recycle items—clear the game without spending a dime![/p][p]💥 [b]Slogans to Ignite Your Blood![/b]
🔹 [b]“One Blade, One World—One City, One Legend!”[/b] – Crown yourself the Shacheng Overlord!
🔹 [b]“Clones by the Thousand—Bosses Tremble in Fear!”[/b] – AFK and conquer the server!
🔹 [b]“F2P to Godhood—Free Until Graduation!”[/b] – Slay mobs for gold, trade gear for real rewards!
🔹 [b]“Lore as Deep as the Ocean—Endless Exploration!”[/b] – 100+ hidden quests unveil the continent’s ultimate secrets!
🔹 [b]“999% Drop Rates—Ascend to Godhood Instantly!”[/b] – Common mobs drop legendaries—bosses gift rare gear![/p][p]🎁 [b]Launch Events: Miss These, Wait Another Year![/b]
🔹 [b]Race to Level 100[/b]: Top 100 players to reach Level 100 on Day 1 earn exclusive fashion + 9,999 gold coins!
🔹 [b]Boss Carnival[/b]: Every night at 20:00, server-wide bosses spawn with doubled drop rates—legendary gear covers the ground!
🔹 [b]Clone Dominator Rankings[/b]: Top 10 clone damage dealers receive limited-edition mounts + titles![/p][p]⏰ [b]Launch Time[/b]: Today at 14:00 on【Shacheng Overlord Zone 1】
💬 [b]Player Group[/b]: 413822706 (Join for rewards, veterans to carry you!)[/p][p][b]Shacheng Awaits Its King![/b]
[b]Brothers, assemble and slash your way to glory in《Shacheng Overlord》![/b] 👑🗡️
[b]– The Legend Never Dies—The Overlord Returns![/b] 🔥[/p]
